items.definition:
the state of being alone or apart from others
He felt a sense of isolation living in the remote cabin.

machines or mechanical parts collectively
The factory uses heavy machinery.

a heavy, silvery-white metallic element; the smallest planet in the solar system
Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.

a precious silvery-white metallic element
Platinum is a very valuable metal.

the extent to which something is likely to happen or be true
There's a high probability of rain tomorrow.

the act of giving up a job or position; acceptance of something undesirable but inevitable
His resignation came as a surprise to everyone.

a religious or solemn ceremony consisting of a series of actions performed according to a prescribed order
The ancient ritual was performed at dawn.

a forceful impact or blow; a loud bang
The door closed with a loud slam.

an electromotive force or potential difference expressed in volts
Check the voltage before plugging in the appliance.

the process of adjusting to new conditions; a movie, television drama, or stage play that has been adapted from a written work
The adaptation of the novel was very popular.

money paid to release someone from jail
He was released on bail.

the stage of human social and cultural development
Ancient civilizations left behind impressive ruins.

a female deity
Athena was the Greek goddess of wisdom.

a person or thing that fails or is defeated
He felt like a loser after losing the game.

the quality, condition, or fact of being exact and accurate
The surgery requires great precision.

the action of preserving something
The preservation of historical buildings is important.

the process of thinking about something in a logical way
Her reasoning for the decision was sound.

the positive aspect of something
The upside of the situation is that we learned a lot.

a strip of leather or cord fastened to a handle, used for flogging or beating
He cracked the whip to make the horses go faster.

a high-ranking officer in the navy
The admiral commanded the fleet.

a sudden, violent, and illegal seizure of power from a government
The military attempted a coup to overthrow the government.

the action or process of getting rid of something
Waste disposal is a major environmental concern.

a remote-controlled unmanned aircraft; a continuous low humming sound
The military uses drones for surveillance.

a person, vehicle, or group accompanying another for protection or as a courtesy
The dignitary arrived with a police escort.

Gross Domestic Product
The country's GDP grew by 3% last year.

an amount of land, property, or shares held by one person or group
The company increased its holding in the rival firm.

a quick, sharp, sudden movement; a foolish or contemptible person
The car stopped with a sudden jerk.

a channel for expression or communication; a shop that sells goods of a particular type
She uses painting as an outlet for her creativity.

a solemn promise or undertaking
The candidate made a pledge to reduce taxes.

a doorway, gate, or other entrance; a website that acts as an entry point to other websites
The website serves as a portal to various government services.

a written order for medicine
The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.

a person who takes part in a public demonstration
The police arrested several protesters during the demonstration.

attention given to someone or something by the media
The new movie generated a lot of publicity.

the process of finding new people to join an organization
The company is focusing on recruitment for new engineers.

an apparatus for sending messages over a distance
The invention of the telegraph revolutionized communication.

a substance used to stimulate the production of antibodies
Scientists are working on a new vaccine for the virus.

a type of strong plastic, or records made from it
He collects old vinyl records.

a group of words containing a subject and a verb
Every contract has a termination clause.

a group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together
There was a cluster of stars visible in the night sky.

the quality of achieving a level of performance which does not vary greatly
Consistency is key to success in sports.

the action of declaring something to be untrue
He issued a strong denial of the accusations.

a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses
She is a successful entrepreneur who started her own tech company.

a journey or voyage undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose
They planned an expedition to the Amazon rainforest.

establishment
The founding of the company was a major event for the city.

meddling
We experienced some interference with the radio signal.

counterbalance
The company bought carbon credits to offset its emissions.

sudden occurrence
There was a sudden outbreak of flu in the region.

investigation
The police launched a full probe into the incident.

a tiny fiery particle; a trace of a quality
A tiny spark flew from the bonfire.

the forming of a theory or conjecture without firm evidence
There was much speculation about the company's future.

a person or thing that succeeds another
The vice president was named as the CEO's successor.

a person, typically one more remote than a grandparent, from whom one is descended
My ancestors came from Ireland.

a difficulty or problem
The surgery had an unexpected complication.

the way a game is played, especially the rules and features that make it enjoyable or interesting
The game's innovative gameplay kept players engaged for hours.

a live performance by a musician or group; a temporary job
The band played a great gig last night.

the natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism
The panda's natural habitat is bamboo forests.

danger or risk
Driving in icy conditions can be a real hazard.

the amount of something taken in
Her daily intake of water is very high.

sympathy and sorrow for the sufferings of others
I felt great pity for the homeless man.

an animal hunted or caught for food
The lion stalked its prey.

a person who speaks for God or a deity
The prophet delivered a message of hope.

a published, broadcast, or recorded work that continues the story or develops the theme of an earlier one
The movie's sequel was even better than the original.

a division of a county with some corporate powers
The township council held a meeting.

a hard, transparent, yellowish-brown substance
The traffic light turned amber.
